items.step: Open Tools → Super Select: Gems on a model that has one semantic gem and one mesh named 'Gem'.
items.machine_proven: tests/super_select_ui.rs: the menu item selects the gem and nothing else (real frame + click).
items.human_must_verify: The lookalike mesh is not selected, even though its name says Gem; the status line reads 'Super Select: Gems: 1 selected'.

items.step: Run the bad-geometry filter on a clean model.
items.machine_proven: G3: it matches only geometry the model's own validate rejects.
items.human_must_verify: A clean model selects nothing and the status says why.

items.machine_proven: G4: every object is skipped with NoOpenVerdict — the verdict is not invented.
items.human_must_verify: You agree that showing 'no verdict yet' is better than guessing, and confirm when the kernel verdict lands (it is a later item).

items.step: Run the duplicate filter on repeated labels.
items.machine_proven: G5: the repeated labels match and the first occurrence keeps its claim.
items.human_must_verify: The duplicates you expect are the ones selected.

items.machine_proven: H5: the gesture writes no transaction.
items.human_must_verify: Undo has nothing to undo from selecting.
